information.description:
The “biggest” gun you can hire from a merc bar isn’t always the most eloquent or sophisticated, but they’re certainly carried by tough bastards that can put down most threats. These brutes support smaller teams with their sheer strength and resilience. Oh, and their scrapped-together heavy machine gun, that matters too.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Mercs).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

Cost: Half (Round Up) the original weapon’s Cost ♦ Availability: Price Category is unchanged

“We live in dangerous times. Violence is rampant, so everyone needs a way to defend themselves. Sadly, many can’t afford effective problem-solvers, which is where bootlegs come to save the day. Yeah, customizing ‘em is a pain and they fall apart easier, but look at that price tag!”

An Ironfake Variant Weapon becomes Exotic if it was not already so, is reduced to Poor Quality, and all of its BODY requirements (if any) are increased by 1 (e.g., BODY 10+ to not jam is now BODY 11+ to not jam). If the weapon was already Poor Quality, its Ironfake Variant now jams when rolling any 1 during the Attack Check (i.e., not negated by Fumble Recovery) and when it malfunctions, it requires an additional Action to clear the malfunction. An Ironfake Weapon cannot be bought using the CEMK’s rule of purchasing it at double its Cost to source it without a Fixer.

Exotic Poor Quality Machine Gun (w/ Power Rebuild). Holds 300 rounds, and is capable of Autofire (Machine Gun 5). Can only use Autofire and Suppressive Fire, both of which expend 20 rounds per use. Requires BODY 12+ to be wielded unless Mounted, and BODY 14+ to not reduce MOVE by 2 while wielded. Requires 3 Actions to Reload.

Variant of: Militech Mk. 31 HMG
Class: Exotic Poor Quality Machine Gun
Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 5), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Autofire and Suppressive Fire only; 2d6 is the standard Autofire damage.
  • Autofire only, so its DV table is the Autofire table.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Exotic weapon.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog > Variants).
Heavier version of an Armorjack for your head. -2 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2

Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

Empty a full clip and you'll still have the energy to take cover.

Internal Body Cyberware. For the purposes of BODY requirements to wield any weapon and/or utilize any of its functions, the user’s BODY is considered one higher. Multiple installations are possible, to a maximum of 3 (e.g., 3 installs gives +3 BODY for wielding weapons).

Type: Internal Body Cyberware
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Not automated: the sheet has one BODY value and this only raises it for weapon requirements.
